tools.name: list-pyth-price-feeds
tools.description: Pyth Price Feeds. Calls only GET /v4/oracle/pyth/pricefeeds and returns that response. Solana API endpoint for fetching available Pyth price product pairs on Solana. Discover all available Pyth price feeds and their associated product accounts.

tools.name: get-pyth-price-candles
tools.description: Pyth Price Candles. Calls only GET /v4/oracle/pyth/pricefeeds/{priceFeedAddress}/candles and returns that response. Solana API endpoint for fetching historical OHLC data from Pyth oracle price feeds. Get open, high, low, close prices for any Pyth price feed account.

tools.name: get-pyth-price
tools.description: Pyth Current Price. Calls only GET /v4/oracle/pyth/pricefeeds/{priceFeedAddress}/price and returns that response. Solana API endpoint for fetching the current Pyth oracle price for any price feed on Solana. Returns price, confidence interval, and EMAP data in real-time.

tools.name: get-market
tools.description: Market Details. Calls only GET /v4/markets/{marketAddress} and returns that response. Solana API endpoint for fetching details about a specific market on Solana. Details are filtered by market or pool address on Pump.fun, Raydium, and more.

tools.name: list-markets
tools.description: Market List. Calls only GET /v4/markets and returns that response. Solana API endpoint for fetching Solana DEX markets by program address. Returns market IDs, token pairs, and program names for Pump.fun, Raydium, and more.

tools.name: get-market-candles
tools.description: Market Price Candles. Calls only GET /v4/markets/{marketAddress}/candles and returns that response. Solana API endpoint for fetching OHLCV candlestick data for a specific Solana market/pool. Returns clean price data from vetted DEX pools and markets.

tools.name: get-pyth-price-history
tools.description: Pyth Price History. Calls only GET /v4/oracle/pyth/pricefeeds/{priceFeedAddress}/price-ts and returns that response. Solana API endpoint for fetching Pyth oracle price time series data on Solana. Get historical price snapshots with confidence intervals for any Pyth price feed.

tools.name: get-pyth-product
tools.description: Pyth Product. Calls only GET /v4/oracle/pyth/products/{productAddress} and returns that response. Solana API endpoint for fetching Pyth product metadata on Solana. Get product account details, asset type, and associated price feed accounts.

tools.name: get-token-candles
tools.description: Token Candles. Calls only GET /v4/tokens/{mintAddress}/candles and returns that response.

tools.name: list-tokens
tools.description: Token List. Calls only GET /v4/tokens and returns that response. Solana API endpoint for fetching Token-2022 and SPL token lists in the form of paginated lists of all tracked Solana tokens with summary metrics.

tools.name: list-labeled-programs
tools.description: Labeled Programs. Calls only GET /v4/programs/labeled-program-accounts and returns that response. Solana API endpoint for fetching known Solana program accounts. Identify labeled program accounts across DEXs and protocols.

tools.name: list-supported-dexes
tools.description: Supported DEXs. Calls only GET /v4/reference/dexes and returns that response. Solana API endpoint for fetching all indexed supported DEXs in the Solana ecosystem. Returns program names, DEXs, protocols, and on-chain programs.

tools.name: get-token-liquidity
tools.description: Token Liquidity. Calls only GET /v4/tokens/{mintAddress}/liquidity and returns that response. Solana API endpoint for fetching total USD liquidity for any Solana token. Aggregates liquidity across all trading markets to assess depth before trading.

tools.name: get-token
tools.description: Token Details. Calls only GET /v4/tokens/{mintAddress} and returns that response. Solana API endpoint for fetching complete Token-2022 and SPL token details such as price, volume, market cap, holder count, supply and social links.

tools.name: get-token-holder-count-history
tools.description: Holder Count History. Calls only GET /v4/tokens/{mintAddress}/holders-count-ts and returns that response. Pass startTime and endTime as unix seconds. endTime minus startTime must be at most 2592000 seconds (30 days). interval is hour or day.

tools.name: list-instruction-names
tools.description: Instruction Names. Calls only GET /v4/reference/instruction-names and returns that response. Solana API endpoint for fetching available token instruction names for Solana programs. Use to filter and categorize on-chain token program interactions.

tools.name: get-token-trader-activity
tools.description: Token Traders Activity. Calls only GET /v4/tokens/{mintAddress}/trader-activity and returns that response. Solana API endpoint for fetching token trader activity. Track buy and sell volumes, PnL (profits/losses) and win/loss to identify active traders and whales.

tools.name: get-token-top-pnl-traders
tools.description: Top PnL Traders (By Token). Calls only GET /v4/tokens/{mintAddress}/top-pnl-traders and returns that response. Solana API endpoint for fetching top token traders by realized and unrealized PnL, including trade volumes, counts, and wallet addresses.

tools.name: get-token-top-holders
tools.description: Top Holders. Calls only GET /v4/tokens/{mintAddress}/top-holders and returns that response. Solana API endpoint for fetching top token holders and whales. Get ownership %, USD value, and labels for top 1000 wallets, updated every 3 hours.

tools.name: list-transfers
tools.description: Transfer History. Calls only GET /v4/transfers and returns that response. Solana API endpoint for fetching historical Token-2022 and SPL transfers by mint, sender, receiver, amount, and time range for analytics and whale tracking.

tools.name: get-swap-quote
tools.description: Swap Quote. Calls only GET /v4/trading/swap-quote and returns that response. Solana API endpoint for fetching Solana swap quotes. Returns expected output, price impact, slippage bounds, and full route plan for any token pair.

tools.name: get-token-trade-volume-history
tools.description: Trade Volume Timeseries. Calls only GET /v4/tokens/{mintAddress}/trade-volume-ts and returns that response. Solana API endpoint for fetching token trade volume over time. Track buy and sell volumes or counts hourly or daily to analyze trading trends.
